description: Bing's own view of a project's domain: daily search performance (clicks/impressions), per-query stats, own-site inbound links, remaining URL Submission quota, crawl diagnostics (crawl stats, crawl issues, crawl settings), submitted feeds and query-parameter settings — read straight from the Bing Webmaster API. FREE (no credits). Bring-your-own-key: requires the deployment operator to set BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY (one key covers every site verified on that Bing account — no per-project connect step). Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account. Backlinks here are OWN-SITE ONLY — Bing exposes no competitor/any-domain backlink lookup, so this does not substitute for general backlink research. Per-URL lookups and keyword research have their own tools: get_bing_url_links, get_bing_url_info, get_bing_keyword_research.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.
